sources.entry: Traduora - Translation management platform for teams. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/K8S/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Traduora is an open-source translation management platform for teams that imports and exports localization files and runs via Docker, Kubernetes, or from source.
summary.what_it_does: Traduora lets a team set up a localization project, import and export translations in several file formats, and work on the same project together with shared membership. It offers instant search across translations and a REST API for automating the translation workflow. Supported formats named in the README include JSON (flat and nested), CSV, YAML (flat and nested), Java Properties, XLIFF 1.2, Gettext (po), Strings, and Android Resources XML. The README says it can be deployed with Docker, Kubernetes, or from source, and it mentions a seed step that creates a default admin user when signups are disabled. A community-contributed CLI exists, which the README says is not official. Automatic translation via third-party integrations is described as a future feature.
use_cases: share translation work with a team
automate translations through a REST API
how_to_run: Run with Docker (pre-built images are on Docker Hub, per the README)
Run on Kubernetes using the deployment docs
Run from source following the Quickstart guide
Set TR_ADMIN_PASSWORD to a non-public password before first start if signups are disabled (TR_SIGNUPS_ENABLED=false)
Seed the default admin user with: yarn seed:default
Run all seeds with: yarn seed
notable: Import and export across many translation file formats including XLIFF 1.2, Gettext po, and Android resources XML
REST API for automating the translation workflow
Automatic seeding of a default admin user at startup controlled by TR_SEED_DATA
Part of the Ever company's open-source platform family alongside Ever Gauzy
caveats: The README says automatic translation via third-party integrations is coming 'soon', so it is not yet available.
Versions 0.21.0 and 0.22.0 shipped a publicly known default admin password; upgrading and changing TR_SECRET is recommended per the README.
The README states the platform is provided AS IS without warranty, and trademarks are restricted by Ever Co. LTD.
